note: Route A (installed MCP server, ids AR-A*) is checked with mcp-use-probe --host archestra and mcp-use-scan --host archestra. Route B (Owned Apps, ids AO-*) is checked with archestra-app-lint; Archestra's validate_app and get_app_diagnostics stay authoritative.

items.title: Every UI tool exposes _meta.ui.resourceUri in tools/list (not only a legacy ui/resourceUri or openai/outputTemplate key), and every ui:// resource is linked by a tool
resources/read on each ui:// resource returns HTML with MIME text/html;profile=mcp-app
Resource _meta.ui.csp lists exactly the origins the HTML loads from (no wildcards); no CSP violations in the host's diagnostics
items.judge: Open the app in Archestra and read get_app_diagnostics or the app card for CSP violations; the probe only sees origins in the HTML text.

items.title: _meta.ui.permissions requests only what the view uses
items.judge: Confirm each requested device permission is used by the view code.

items.title: Every tool a view calls is reachable from the view: not declared visibility "model"
The viewer has access to the installation (the host answers 403 otherwise)
items.judge: UNVERIFIED: documented only in the earlier skill, not in the Archestra pages read here. Check in a real Archestra with a second user.

items.title: The credential model is confirmed: viewer's credentials or the installation's own
items.judge: UNVERIFIED: Archestra's apps page says tools run with the active viewer's credentials; the earlier skill says the installation's. Test with two users before relying on either.

items.title: Inline height is reported by the host size notification (mcp-use autoResize, on by default)
items.judge: Check the view does not set autoResize false or a fixed height.

items.title: Theme comes from the host context (useViewTheme), not prefers-color-scheme
items.judge: Search the view and its CSS for prefers-color-scheme.

items.title: No unguarded dependency on window.openai or other ChatGPT-only APIs
Model-context features are guarded; support for installed servers is not confirmed
Owned-App HTML passes the save gate (no SDK self-bootstrap, no platform script or stylesheet tags, parses, at most 512 KB, known uiPermissions)
Owned-App HTML passes validate_app without warnings (document root, CDN allowlist, async storage partitions, SDK members)
Owned-App HTML follows the documented sandbox and SDK rules (no network, iframes, native forms, target=_blank; storage, ready, tool names, limits)
